propositions: _blame_file_commits must distinguish git failure (return None) from successful-but-empty blame (return []) so derive_caused_by can detect and abort on per-path failures
derive_caused_by can write a wrong caused_by link when blame succeeds on some paths and fails on others, causing the strict-majority culprit election to run over a subset rather than the full set
blobless git clone with --filter=blob:none degrades performance acceptably (68.7 MiB / 14.3 s vs full 1.04 GiB / 59 s) and must be documented as the only accepted degradation
--filter=tree:0 must not be used for clones as it produces 3.57 GiB (3.4x larger than full), contradicting the blobless guidance
derive_caused_by is invoked on every bug close without explicit --caused-by, and blobless promisor faults blobs one at a time during blame, making partial failure plausible
